## Annex: what this directive tells our side

| Their move | Our standing answer (where it lives) |
|---|---|
| Collateral attack; indefeasibility | Direct attack pleaded in the caption and prayer; MTC jurisdiction by assessed value (War of the Statutes §1). |
| "Read as a whole"; Arts. 1900, 1902, 1911 | Art. 1900 protects acts "within the terms of the power of attorney as written"; the class and the consultation are the written terms, annotated in 1996 (§3). Art. 1911 creates liability, not a conveyance (§3). |
| Art. 1403 ratification by accepting payments; Hansol 1999 | Art. 1409(7): void cannot be ratified; payments went to the agent's side, never to a principal; Hansol was before 2005 and under the 1991 power (§4). |
| Art. 1922 publication only forward; §64 revocation unregistered | Lead with the class, not the revocation; §52: what was registered in 1996 was the power with its limits; §64 is a direction, not a condition (§5). Never argue 1922 both ways. |
| Prosecutor's "landowner" and "lawful right" lines | Same resolution: "cannot pass upon the issue of ownership"; mailed to the respondents 23 Sep 2020 (King cases dig). |
| The Violeta book; a Violeta-era witness; a 1980s paper | Any Llamanzares-era paper must come through Salvador's 1992 collection (S15) or from the Agcaoili office; subpoena Salvador to bring it first (documents-only case, Part 3). A late witness is tested on the gates in the trajectory, Part 3. Our own quiet ask to the Agcaoili office about the book comes first. |
| "Do not bring the booklets" | Rule 131 §3(e): evidence willfully suppressed is presumed adverse. The subpoena for stubs and duplicates is drafted and held (audit, P1 to P15). |
| Partition date as "clerical" | An agreement cannot recite a plan surveyed three years later; the Registry file will show who signed and when it was really made (RD requests; Art. 496). |
| King's conviction; King's Ferrer house; de los Reyes's hearsay; De Leon's father | Acquittal certified copies in hand; the Ferrer question answered before she is asked; de los Reyes's Q2 to Q3, Q7, Q9 withdrawn or she is not called; De Leon's father's seller named before 4 Nov (witness pack). |
| Motion to strike L, M, N on the jurat; object to re-sworn copies | Confirm the 2026 commission now; if none, re-swear and file by 30 Oct with the witness affirming on the stand (pack Part 1.1; Note 4). |
| Oppose Patricia's late affidavit and videoconference | Rule 30 §5(f) rebuttal; the once-only leave kept for her; the route question is with counsel (Note 3). Her inheritance under Const. Art. XII §7 is in her draft. |
| Demurrer after we rest | The documents-only case answers each demurrer ground from the record and their Answer; Annex A of the draft Motion to Resolve lists the nineteen facts. |
| Non-joinder of Cesar's estate | Rule 3 §11: not a ground for dismissal; the estate may be impleaded if the court so orders (trajectory, Part 1). |
| Harassment counterclaim from the agency complaints | The referrals stay out of our case-in-chief; a suit that succeeds on title cannot be malicious (War of the Statutes §10). |
| Silence, delay, appeal, stay in the house | Press the summary judgment ruling on paper now; fruits from the 22 Aug 2025 demand (Art. 549); execution pending appeal on the possession award is counsel's call. |

**Two things the exercise adds to our list.** First, ask the Agcaoili office now, quietly, whether any Violeta or Llamanzares collection papers came to them with Cesar's files, before the other side asks by subpoena. Second, keep the agency complaints and the February 2026 letter out of our case entirely; they are the only material the defense can use to make the counterclaim look like a case.
